description: Search generated registry artifacts for likely duplicate entries before a user opens a submission PR.

brandDomain.description: Brand's canonical domain (e.g. 'example.com') to check for duplicates.

category.description: Category to scope the duplicate search.

docsUrl.description: Documentation URL to check for duplicates.

downloadUrl.description: Download or release URL to check for duplicates.

githubUrl.description: GitHub repository URL to check for duplicates.

limit.description: Maximum number of duplicate candidates to return (1–10).

name.description: Tool or resource name to search for near-duplicates.

slug.description: Slug to check for an exact existing entry.

sourceUrl.description: Primary source URL to check against existing entries.

sourceUrls.description: Multiple source URLs to check (e.g. GitHub repo + docs site).

title.description: Display title to search for near-duplicates.

websiteUrl.description: Homepage or product URL to check for duplicates.

name: submission.duplicates
